userStories.title: README rewrite
acceptanceCriteria: README.md leads with the tagline 'Your AI usage coach.' followed by the four-step loop (Commit / Cue / Reflect / Review) and an `install` -> `praxis install-coach` quickstart.
The string 'scorecard' (case-insensitive) does not appear anywhere in README.md; existing rubric + research-grounding sections are retained but moved below the loop description.
A test (or grep-based CI check) asserts the README contains the headings '# Praxis', '## The loop', and the four verbs by name; if any are missing, the test fails.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis

userStories.title: `praxis --help` reorganisation
acceptanceCriteria: `praxis --help` lists commit, nudge, reflect, review, install-coach first under a 'Loop' or 'Coaching' heading; scan, re-score, baseline, history, show, report, open, last, status, rubric, follow-up, models, config, install-weekly, uninstall-weekly, shell-nudge, install-shell-nudge, uninstall-shell-nudge appear under a 'More' heading.
`praxis week --help` exits non-zero (the verb was removed in US-033); `praxis review --help` succeeds and matches the new masthead documentation.
An automated test captures stdout of `praxis --help` and asserts the ordering: 'commit' appears before 'scan' in the output text.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
